description: Operator-selection LP duals over the nuclide chart at q_0, NO FLOAT64 (mpmath 50 dps NF + tr_m_mp/gram_matrix_mp), superseding the f64 producer whose native build_atom_nf overflowed for 37.6% of the chart (A>=163), making Z=82 and Z=126 unreachable. Records the q-convolution realisation used in generative isotope production, and flags its knot-operator identification as unresolved.

convolution.operator: q-convolution = mate of the comultiplication Delta_q on H_q
convolution.character_level_realisation: tensor product of Specht modules, i.e. Littlewood-Richardson fusion; F and L intertwine it with the pointwise product on irreducibles

braid_level_realisation.quark_proton: uu -> sigma_0 ; ud -> sigma_0 mixed (-h/2) ; ud -> sigma_1 mixed (-h/2)
braid_level_realisation.quark_neutron: ud -> sigma_0 mixed (-h/2) ; ud -> sigma_0 mixed (-h/2) ; dd -> sigma_1^-1 (-h)
braid_level_realisation.which_part_is_the_convolution: the inter-nucleon double loop over all previously placed nucleons; the per-nucleon block builds the factor being convolved

convolution.knot_operator_status: No content block identifies which knot operation realises this convolution. The Fourier / Laplace / resolvent blocks name the algebraic operator (the Delta_q-mate) but not its knot-diagram counterpart. OPEN, not absent: the search surface was a keyword grep over content/ and computations/ plus a read of the hits.
